description: This Java source file is a unit test class named `ResourceCreatedTest`. It tests the behavior and correctness of the `ResourceCreated` class, including immutability, equals/hashCode, JSON serialization/deserialization, and validation scenarios.

classes.name: ResourceCreatedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the correctness and behavior of the ResourceCreated class, including immutability, equality, JSON conversions, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the ResourceCreated class is immutable and that related classes like Label and Policy are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods of ResourceCreated are correctly implemented using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ResourceCreated instance with null policy ID string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ResourceCreated instance with null PolicyId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullLabel
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ResourceCreated instance with null label throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullResource
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ResourceCreated instance with null resource throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the toJson method of ResourceCreated produces the expected JSON output.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests that a ResourceCreated instance can be correctly created from a valid JSON string.
